-26.26481,151.86419.ins: This plaque is in memory of Jim Brady, David Ferrier, Tony Hammett (Pilot), Ken Newton, Peter Wier, who died tragically from a plane crash at 10.46 pm on 26.7.1990, and in recognition of an outstanding and compassionate community effort at the scene.

-26.46996,151.37693.ins: Original site of the Burrandowan State School, Opened 10 May 1923. Closed 12 September 1943

-26.47079,151.37969.ins: Original site of the Chahpingah School of Arts erected for the settlers of Chahpingah in 1926. Moved to nearby [racecourse] in 1998

-26.471,151.3803.ins: The Burrandowan Bush Nursing Service operated from this site from 1923 until 1935. This plaque was presented to the Chahpingah Reserve Association by te children of Bena (Rose and Wilfred Freshwater in memory of their mother who served here ...

-26.47132,151.38134.ins: Original site of the Chahpingah Telephone Exchange and Carriers Depot 1931-1943

-26.64219,151.70635.ins: Original site of Benair State School 1911-1977

-27.61022,151.93466.ins: This Spanish Chestnut Tree commemorates an avenue of these trees planted by John Handley of Paradise Farm in the years, 1865-75. This plaque unveiled by his decendants[sic] on 2-4-83.

-27.61502,151.96868.ins: Francis (Frank) Dorge (1909-1993) had a strong affinity with these forest clad escarpment slopes and wanted them to be enjoyed by the people of Toowoomba. Through his generosity this bridge has been built to complete this southern portion of the Glen Lomo
